name: Radar Amplifier - Re-ATK
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Re-ATK capability.

61180.name: TacW Guidance II · Re-ATK
61180.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
After triggering [Re-ATK], Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
